_about: The shape of a rendered-loops manifest for dio-layer.js (R4). The real one is dio-loops.json, written by blender/build_dionysus.py; another can be given with index.html?loops=<path>. rect and head are in world units (prototype B's SVG space: he stands at x 800, feet at y 672). 'loops' is the default finish (painted marble); 'finishes' holds the other finishes (Q8), each with the same seven loops, loaded only when chosen. A loop is a list of frames or a video. A recipe step plays its loop for at least 3.2 s, then repeats from 'hold' (a frame index, or seconds for video) while he waits for your tap; hold 0 means a cycle whose first frame is the still he waits on. A loop missing from a finish falls back to the default finish's loop, dip falls back to stir, anything else to polish.
